notes: Requires a valid bearer API key but no additional scope. Returns the organization, project, environment, current API key summary, and dashboard owner contact for account/key identification.
Alias of GET /v1/account for agents and clients that look for a whoami-style route.

Production sends require a verified business identity (KYC, ADR-022) — verified instantly when the customer accepts the truthfulness declaration in dashboard Settings (self-declared, no banking data). Because NFS-e service notes are emitted on consumption, the tomador identity must exist by the first taxable send; unverified organizations fail with 403 authorization_error and stable code kyc_required (no identity / rejected) or kyc_pending (submitted, not yet verified) before any message row is written. Sandbox sends are never KYC-gated.
Capability-token URL. The signed path token is the sole authority; no API key scope is required.
Capability-token URL. The signed path token is the sole authority; no API key scope is required.

Sandbox keys can listen directly. Production keys must pass a short-lived listen_session_id from POST /v1/webhook-events/listen-sessions; production reads are bounded to events created after the session opened. Optional start_at=tail starts after the current retained stream. Optional webhook_endpoint_id filters to that endpoint subscription and attaches a signature_preview for verifier probes.
Production keys only. Creates one short-lived diagnostic listen session so production polling cannot become a long-running webhook transport.
Disables a production webhook listen session before its automatic expiry.

Sandbox keys can retrieve directly. Production keys must pass an active listen_session_id and can retrieve only events created after that session opened. Optional webhook_endpoint_id attaches a signature_preview for verifier probes.
Sandbox keys only. Reports sender, approved-template, scope, and local listen readiness.
Unauthenticated RFC 8628-shaped API-key bootstrap. Creates a short-lived device request and returns a dashboard verification URL for an owner/admin to approve.
Unauthenticated polling endpoint. Returns 202 pending until approval, then one-time kind=agent API key credentials plus preflight checks. This does not issue OAuth access tokens for /v1/* routes.
Rotates the active webhook trigger signing secret and returns the plaintext secret once.
Public webhook trigger URL. The slug identifies the automation trigger; requests must include tyxter-webhook-timestamp and tyxter-webhook-signature headers signed with the trigger secret.
Org-scoped invoice list with cursor pagination; optional project_id query filter narrows to one project.
Returns a short-lived (15 minute) presigned CSV download URL for a ready invoice. Cross-org lookups return 404, never 403.

Agent-facing failure reporting (ADR-025). Any valid live or sandbox key; no scope required; Idempotency-Key mandatory. Accepted even when production credit is exhausted. Submitter-asserted related_error and a flat string context are stored as untrusted data; tenant provenance is server-derived. Content is credential-redacted before storage. Returns a minimal receipt that never echoes the report.

Org-scoped, environment-agnostic NFS-e list with cursor pagination (no project_id — fiscal is org-level, ADR-027). Optional status / source_kind filters. A sandbox key reads the same org fiscal documents; emission itself is production-only.
Cross-org lookups return 404, never 403. Never exposes the cert, signed DPS, stored event bodies, or config snapshots.

Returns a short-lived (15 minute) presigned DANFSE PDF download URL. 409 fiscal_document_not_ready until the note is authorized/canceled/substituted and the artifact exists. Reachable even when production credit is exhausted (legal tax document).
Returns a short-lived (15 minute) presigned authorized NFS-e XML download URL. 409 fiscal_document_not_ready until ready. Reachable even when production credit is exhausted.

Production requests require a verified business identity (KYC, ADR-022) — verified instantly when the customer accepts the truthfulness declaration in dashboard Settings (self-declared, no banking data). Unverified organizations fail with 403 authorization_error and stable code kyc_required (no identity / rejected) or kyc_pending (submitted, not yet verified) before any row is written. Production requests then reserve the first phone.number.month BRL charge before Salvy is called; insufficient funds return 402 payment_required with stable code insufficient_balance. Sandbox provisioning is KYC-free and does not reserve or debit balance. All provision requests share a per-organization rate limit (burst 5, sustained 10/hour) returning 429 rate_limited with Retry-After; production requests additionally enforce a cap on concurrently held Salvy numbers per organization (deployment default 2) returning 409 conflict with stable code phone_number_limit_reached — release a number to free its slot.
Idempotency-Key is required so the one-time launch bearer can be deterministically replayed without storing plaintext.
Finishes a pending Meta WhatsApp connection from its stored credentials. No request body.
Sandbox keys only. Creates a deterministic inbound message for local webhook and flow testing.
Sandbox keys only. Forces rejected, paused, or disabled template provider states for send-refusal tests.
Sandbox keys only. Forces paid, failed, expired, or cancelled payment request states and emits the matching customer-visible payment event.

Sandbox keys only. Arms a one-shot (or TTL-bounded) LLM provider failure the next completion will surface, so integrators can test their error handling deterministically. Re-arming replaces the current fixture.
Uses Tyxter platform-owned template generation credentials to draft an approved-ready WhatsApp template from a short business description.

Reads the environment data-retention policy (ADR-033). An environment with no policy row returns the platform default (retention_days 90, data_export_enabled true) with updated_at null — never a 404. Scoped to the key principal environment; sandbox and production behave identically.

Upserts the environment data-retention policy. At least one of retention_days (7-365) or data_export_enabled is required. project_id/environment_id are sourced from the key principal, never the body; a retention_policy.updated audit row is written on every change.
